acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p jmap-mail-server submission passes; clippy clean; 5 new filter tests pass
description:
RFC 8621 §7.3: EmailSubmission/query must parse and apply FilterCondition. EmailSubmissionFilterCondition is ALREADY DEFINED in jmap-mail-types with fields: identity_ids (Vec<Id>), email_ids (Vec<Id>), thread_ids (Vec<Id>), undo_status (UndoStatus), before (UTCDate), after (UTCDate). NOTE: there is NO 'onSuccess' field in the query filter (that is in Email/set request args, not here). Currently handle_submission_query (submission.rs line 119) hardcodes None for filter (line 171).

Algorithm:
1. In handle_submission_query (submission.rs line ~130), after parsing limit/position/anchor, add:
   let filter_val = args.get("filter");
   let filter: Option<Filter<EmailSubmissionFilterCondition>> = match filter_val {
       None | Some(Value::Null) => None,
       Some(v) => Some(serde_json::from_value(v.clone()).map_err(|e| JmapError::invalid_arguments(e.to_string()))?),
   };
2. Pass filter to backend.query_objects::<EmailSubmission> call (line 171 and ~198)
3. In tests/common/mod.rs MemoryBackend::query_objects, add EmailSubmission branch:
   - When O::TYPE_NAME == 'EmailSubmission', downcast filter to Option<&Filter<EmailSubmissionFilterCondition>>
   - Actually: query_objects receives filter as Option<&O::Filter> — for EmailSubmission, Filter type = Filter<EmailSubmissionFilterCondition>. Implement matching: for each submission, apply each condition: check identity_ids contains submission.identity_id, check email_ids contains submission.email_id, check before > submission.send_at, check after <= submission.send_at, check undo_status matches. All conditions AND'd.
4. Implement filter matching helper fn matches_submission_filter(sub: &EmailSubmission, cond: &EmailSubmissionFilterCondition) -> bool

Defensive rules: invalid filter JSON → invalidArguments (not server error); unknown filter fields → silently ignored (serde default); no array bounds check needed (Filter<T> handles nesting); UTCDate parsing handled by serde.

Tests:
- submission_query_filter_by_identity_id: create 2 identities + 2 submissions; filter by identity1 → only sub1 returned
- submission_query_filter_by_before: create submission with sendAt T; filter before=T+1s → included; before=T-1s → excluded
- submission_query_filter_by_after: symmetric of before
- submission_query_filter_by_undo_status: filter by 'final' → matches only final submissions
- submission_query_invalid_filter_type: pass number as filter → invalidArguments error
title: EmailSubmission/query: implement FilterCondition
